translation.name: Brazil
translation.summary: Rio de Janeiro, Iguaçu Falls, the Amazon, the Pantanal and the Atlantic coast. A private journey through Brazil can focus on cities, nature or beaches — or bring all three together.

featureBands.title: Rio de Janeiro
featureBands.text: Rio is often the starting point for a journey: the ocean, Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain and neighbourhoods with very different atmospheres.

featureBands.title: Lençóis Maranhenses
featureBands.text: White dunes and seasonal lagoons create one of Brazil's most unusual natural landscapes.

featureBands.title: River, forest and lodge
featureBands.text: Allow several days for the Amazon and plan internal flights, the season and your preferred lodge experience in advance.

translation.body:
Brazil offers strikingly different experiences: Rio and the ocean, Iguaçu Falls, the Amazon, the Pantanal and the country's north-east. For one journey, choose a few highlights and give each enough time.

Ada Tours then brings the domestic flights, transfers, hotels and excursions together in a single programme.
